_doc: RC6: rows in spec.NATIVE_MENU_HOLD stay out of the menu (page and storage) until the game's own graphics XML from the player's installation proves their engine variable is not set by a native graphics-menu option. 'held' = not shipped; 'released' = shipped (requires the evidence sha256).

evidence.source: WCC kit rev11 read-only scan of the player's ...\bin\config\r4game\user_config_matrix\pc (21 XML files)
evidence.finding: No game or mod menu XML references TerrainReadAheadDistance; it is not part of any native graphics option. Saved by the game (0x102): applied session-only (save bit detached while owned).

graphics.xml option Virtual_FoliageVisibility ("Foliage Visibility Range", refreshEngine;customPresetIfChanged) sets FoliageDistanceScale for every level (1 / 1.2 / 1.5 / 1.8 / 1.8). A URT override would change what that native option shows and could turn the graphics preset to Custom. Not shipped.
evidence.rc7_decision: Released at the player's request with the RC7 protections: FoliageDistanceScale is saved by the game (0x102) -> session-only ownership (save bit detached while owned; value restored first, bit second); the native option Virtual_FoliageVisibility keeps its own stored selection (player observed no change of the native menu); any write by the game or another mod releases the row and URT waits for the next game save before taking it again, so a native Foliage Visibility Range change is saved first. Gameplay confirmation required.
evidence.rc8_decision: RC7 gameplay test: changing it changed the native Foliage Visibility Range setting. Permanently removed in RC8; FoliageDistanceScale is never bound, read or written by URT.
